newsitem.title: USA: FDA to ban recycled protein in animal feed - paper.
newsitem.headline: FDA to ban recycled protein in animal feed - paper.

text.p: The Wall Street Journal reported Thursday that the Food and Drug Administration is expected to soon propose a ban against the recycling of waste animal protein into livestock feed.
The ban would restrict the use of meat and bone meal and other protein derived from slaughtered ruminants as a feed ingredient for other ruminants.
The ban will be proposed to prevent an outbreak of the so-called mad cow disease, or bovine spongiform encephalopathy (BSE).

According to the article, the FDA proposal would classify as unsafe all forms of protein derived from cattle, sheep, goats, deer, elk and milk, and would also cover protein from animals which are dead, dying, diseased or diabled when reaching the rendering plant.
FDA officials were not available for immediate comment.
